acceptance_criteria.criterion: Draft→Ready promotion must require current ready_checks security/evidence success before mark_ready; pending stays Draft and failure stays Draft/fails closed.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: ready_checks now runs after exact-head/base/node recheck and before mutation; explicit pending/failure regressions pass.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: If post-mutation confirmation detects HEAD/base/node/state race, the still-open Ready PR must be restored to Draft using the existing mutation token.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: post-mutation mismatch now invokes convert_to_draft fail-closed; dedicated HEAD-race and base-race regressions pass.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: If pre-Ready security/evidence checks are pending after preflight completion, trusted Candidate Admission must reconcile later without manual Ready intervention, using the same controller and current live PR state.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Existing Candidate Admission workflow now has a bounded trusted schedule fallback every ten minutes; scheduled runs enumerate current candidate PRs and omit stale event head binding, forcing fresh exact-head evaluation. 412 focused tests + Defect Prevention Guard + Ruff pass.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Scheduled Candidate Admission reconciliation must continue across all open candidates when an earlier PR fails admission, while still returning aggregate failure after the sweep.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Workflow loop now captures each candidate nonzero result, continues the sweep, and exits nonzero afterward if any failed. 413 focused tests + Defect Prevention Guard + Ruff pass.
